subject: general
question:
Five persons, P, Q, R, S and T travelled in different months of the same year viz. January, February, March, April and May.

R travelled in February. Only one person travelled between R and S. Only three people travelled between Q and T. T travelled in a month after S. Who among them travelled in May?
solution:
**Given:** Five persons, P, Q, R, S and T travelled in different months of the same year viz. January, February, March, April and May.

1) R travelled in February.

2) Only one person travelled between R and S.

 
 

 **Month**
 **Persons**
 
 

 January (31)
 
 
 

 February (28/29)
 R
 
 

 March (31)
 
 
 

 April (30)
 S
 
 

 May (31)
 
 
 

3) Only three people travelled between Q and T.

4) T travelled in a month after S.

 
 

 **Month**
 **Persons**
 
 

 January (31)
 Q
 
 

 February (28/29)
 R
 
 

 March (31)
 P
 
 

 April (30)
 S
 
 

 May (31)
 T
 
 

So, **'T' travelled in may**

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
